summary: Member login with email and password
description:
As a Surveyz member I want to sign in with my email address and password so that I can reach my dashboard and see my reward balance.

The login form has an email field, a password field, and a Login button. Field validation runs on blur. The service is only available to members in Australia; traffic from elsewhere is blocked by a modal that cannot be dismissed.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Given valid credentials, submitting the form signs the member in and lands them on the dashboard home page.
- The dashboard header greets the signed-in member by first name and shows their reward balance.
- Given an incorrect password, the member stays on the login page and sees an error that does not reveal whether the email address is registered.
- The Login button stays disabled until both the email and the password field hold valid values.
- The password field masks its value.
- Members outside Australia see the geo-restriction modal instead of the dashboard.
_note: Example snapshot, hand-written so the pipeline can be demoed without Jira credentials. scripts/jira-fetch.js overwrites this file with real data once JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN are set.
